text: {"fixed_clause": "To ensure operational stability and administrative efficiency, records and applicant files compiled during the recruitment cycle are maintained exclusively within internal archives, while data subjects retain their rights to be informed of the legal basis and purpose of collection, to access their personal data, to request correction, completion, or update, and to request destruction of data no longer needed."}

data.fixed_clause: To ensure operational stability and administrative efficiency, records and applicant files compiled during the recruitment cycle are maintained exclusively within internal archives, while data subjects retain their rights to be informed of the legal basis and purpose of collection, to access their personal data, to request correction, completion, or update, and to request destruction of data no longer needed.
